_meta.note: TRAIN/DEV split for the Phase-6 optimizer; the 24-Q eval stays the pure held-out test.
_meta.source: eval/optimization_trainset.jsonl over data/*.csv via DuckDB (same oracle as ground_truth.py)

T-M01.question: Which five sites have the highest single turbidity measurement recorded?
T-M01.sql: SELECT s.site_name FROM water_quality_measurements m JOIN sites s ON m.site_id = s.site_id ORDER BY m.turbidity_ntu DESC LIMIT 5

T-M02.question: Which monitored sites have recorded a measurement whose dominant algae species belongs to the phylum Dinoflagellata?
T-M02.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.site_name FROM water_quality_measurements m JOIN sites s ON m.site_id = s.site_id JOIN algae_species a ON m.dominant_species_id = a.species_id WHERE a.phylum = 'Dinoflagellata' ORDER BY s.site_name

T-M03.question: Which treatment methods have been applied at Lake Rotorua Central?
T-M03.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.method FROM treatment_records t JOIN sites s ON t.site_id = s.site_id WHERE s.site_name = 'Lake Rotorua Central' ORDER BY t.method

T-M04.question: Which algae species appear as the dominant species in measurements taken at estuary sites?
T-M04.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.scientific_name FROM water_quality_measurements m JOIN sites s ON m.site_id = s.site_id JOIN algae_species a ON m.dominant_species_id = a.species_id WHERE s.water_body_type = 'estuary' ORDER BY a.scientific_name

T-M05.question: How many water-quality measurements were taken at Sacramento River at Redding?
T-M05.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM water_quality_measurements m JOIN sites s ON m.site_id = s.site_id WHERE s.site_name = 'Sacramento River at Redding'

T-M06.question: For sites located in the USA, which treatment methods have been applied?
T-M06.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.method FROM treatment_records t JOIN sites s ON t.site_id = s.site_id WHERE s.country = 'USA' ORDER BY t.method

T-M07.question: What is the average chlorophyll-a (ug/L) for measurements whose dominant species is Anabaena flos-aquae, to two decimals?
T-M07.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(m.chlorophyll_a_ugl), 2) AS avg_chl FROM water_quality_measurements m JOIN algae_species a ON m.dominant_species_id = a.species_id WHERE a.scientific_name = 'Anabaena flos-aquae'

T-M08.question: Which sites have recorded a measurement whose dominant species has moderate toxicity?
T-M08.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.site_name FROM water_quality_measurements m JOIN sites s ON m.site_id = s.site_id JOIN algae_species a ON m.dominant_species_id = a.species_id WHERE a.toxicity_level = 'moderate' ORDER BY s.site_name

T-S01.question: How many monitored sites are lakes?
T-S01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM sites WHERE water_body_type = 'lake'

T-S02.question: How many monitored sites are located in Australia?
T-S02.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM sites WHERE country = 'Australia'

T-S03.question: What distinct toxicity levels are recorded for algae species?
T-S03.sql: SELECT DISTINCT toxicity_level FROM algae_species ORDER BY toxicity_level

T-S04.question: How many algae species belong to the phylum Bacillariophyta?
T-S04.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM algae_species WHERE phylum = 'Bacillariophyta'

T-S05.question: What is the average dissolved oxygen concentration (mg/L) across all water-quality measurements, to two decimals?
T-S05.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(dissolved_oxygen_mgl), 2) AS avg_do FROM water_quality_measurements

T-S06.question: What is the highest nitrate reading recorded, in mg/L?
T-S06.sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(nitrate_mgl), 2) AS max_nitrate FROM water_quality_measurements
